adult-clothing-footwear.note: Amazon gates Clothing and Accessories. We gate known brands and keep the category open.

baby-food-formula.note: Formula needs the FDA infant formula notification and a purchase invoice.

bakery-products.note: Seller-baked is food service. A resold factory product is packaged food.

car-seats.note: FMVSS 213 certificate and insurance. New only.

childrens-clothing.note: Children's product certificate and tracking label.

cleaning-paper-products.note: Dangerous goods answer applies to cleaners.

dairy-eggs.note: Cold chain documents. Ships express or local only.

decor-candles.note: Candles ask the dangerous goods question.

dietary-supplements.note: Supplement Facts photo, insurance, and a certificate of analysis.

energy-protein-drink-mixes.note: If it makes health claims it moves to Dietary supplements.

fabrics-textiles.note: Provisional catalog category, not in the approved matrix: treated as Clothing, shoes, bags (FSH) and open until the owner decides.

first-aid-wound-care.note: Low risk items such as plasters and gauze. Staff can gate a product.

fresh-produce.note: Cold chain documents. Ships express or local only.

frozen-meals.note: Made by the seller means food service rules apply.

furniture-small-appliances.note: Model number and electrical certificate for appliances.

gift-baskets-bundles.note: Blocked until bundles can be itemised for tax.

gift-cards.note: Fraud controls and tax approval first.

hair-beauty-appointments.note: Cosmetology licence where the state requires one.

jewelry-accessories.note: Fashion and beaded jewelry are open. Gold, silver, gemstones and watches need approval.

meat-poultry-fish.note: Cold chain documents and supplier invoice.

medical-devices.note: FDA listing for the device class.

medicated-skincare.note: Amazon gates topicals. Drug Facts photo and documents.

nuts-seeds.note: Servings and weight decide the tax outcome.

otc-medicines.note: Drug Facts photo and NDC or FDA listing.

perfumes-fragrances.note: Flammable, so the dangerous goods answer applies. Brand authenticity invoice.

pet-food.note: Species and life stage. Label photo.

phones.note: Renewed phones need a grade and warranty.

prepared-meals.note: Needs the verified Food service capability and permit.

toys-games.note: Age grade and CPSIA or ASTM F963 certificate. Amazon tightens this in the holiday season.
